text:
dmitri: Heads-up — ran into a weird conversion failure when bringing up a new HF chat_template. Jinja has a conditional block + custom role 'moderator' and after conversion the system message gets duplicated and roles are interleaved.

caroline: ugh. can you paste the original template? quick glance might show why.

dmitri: sure, minimal snippet:
```jinja
{%- set meta = meta if meta is defined else {} -%}
{% if meta.system_prompt %}
- role: system
  content: |
    {{ meta.system_prompt }}
{% endif %}
{% for m in messages %}
- role: {{ m.role }}
  content: |
    {{ m.content }}
{% endfor %}
{% if moderator_comment %}
- role: moderator
  content: "{{ moderator_comment }}"
{% endif %}
```

caroline: i think the converter is treating `moderator` as an assistant alias and then injecting a default system bos token. did you enable `preserve_sentinels`?

dmitri: no, default flags. also tokenization looks odd on our side. when i render locally i see:
```text
<systart>\nSYSTEM: Please follow safety rules\n</systart>\nUSER: hello\nASSISTANT: hi\nMODERATOR: watch out\n```
which then gets converted to:
```text
SYSTEM: Please follow safety rules\nSYSTEM: Please follow safety rules\nUSER: hello\nASSISTANT: hi\n```
so moderator content is gone and system repeats. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

eva: this rings a bell — tokenizer config difference: HF models often set `add_bos_token=true` in config.json implicitly, Redwood runtime expects explicit role sentinels and strips BOS. if the converter inserts a sentinel like `<|system|>` but tokenizer splits it into `<|` `system` `|>` tokens we can get role token leakage and duplication after postprocessing.

mike: can you dump the token ids around the start? even a tiny example helps repro.

dmitri: pasted tokenized slice:
```
[101, 32, 60, 124, 115, 121, 115, 116, 101, 109, 124, 62, 200, ...]
```
so `<|system|>` became split and also there's a leading 101 which is the BOS.

caroline: yep, that explains it. converter assumed sentinel is atomic and removed the BOS, tokenizer didn't. two removals -> duplication. quick patch: treat any `role` that is not in {system, user, assistant} as `user` during conversion, and add an optional `preserve_bos` flag to the converter to avoid double-strip.

leah: please file an issue and add a small repro + config.json + tokenizer settings. tag eng-runtime. i'll triage.

ml-bot: [regression-alert] nightly-quant-eval failed on this model: rouge-l dropped 7.2 points vs baseline. Possibly prompt formatting caused truncation on canary.

mike: linking the repro to the regression might be important — if the system content lost -> evaluation context changes. dmitri, can you include the failing eval case?

dmitri: pasted failing case (short):
```
System: Please follow safety rules
User: Summarize the following text...
[long article body]
```
output got cut right after the first sentence. when i reran with `preserve_sentinels=true` the model returned full summary.

caroline: temporary mitigation: in the converter CLI pass `--sentinel-mode=preserve` and set `--normalize-roles=false`. i'll put a small patch in PR and add unit tests for: (a) nonstandard role name -> default user, (b) bos handling, (c) sentinel tokenization split.

leah: assign to @caroline and add to release notes under "hf->rw converter: sentinel & BOS fixes". also mention the eval regression link.

dmitri: thanks, will add the tiny repro and token dumps to the issue. i think this explains multiple odd bring-ups we've seen.

mike: 👍
